svg.title: When each part of the shader toolchain runs
svg.desc: Three horizontal bars on a shared scale. Build time is 61.2 milliseconds — four shaders, three compilation hops each, paid once per edit. Program start is 0.028 milliseconds for all four calls to SDL_CreateGPUShader, roughly two thousand times cheaper and far too fast to include compiling anything. The third bar, first draw, is drawn empty and dashed: the real compile has not happened yet, and Lesson 4.4 is where it shows up.
svg.text: when each part of the toolchain runs, and what it costs
four shaders, three hops each, once per edit
the real compile — Lesson 4.4 finds it
Eight microseconds cannot be a compile. The MSL is handed over at start and turned into machine code
later — when the driver finally knows the target formats and vertex layout it must be specialised to.
